entries.quote:

entries.quote:
Of things some are in our power, and others are not. In our power are opinion
([Greek: hupolaepsis]), movement towards a thing ([Greek: hormae]), desire,
aversion ([Greek: echchlisis]), turning from a thing; and in a word, whatever
are our acts. Not in our power are the body, property, reputation, offices
(magisterial power), and in a word, whatever are not our own acts.

entries.hinglish: Sab kuch aapke bas mein nahi. Ek chhota influence dhoondhna, poori zimmedari uthana nahi hai.
entries.why: Epictetus draws a strict ancient distinction about control. Today, thoughts and feelings are not simply chosen; the useful question is what practical influence you have.
entries.prompt: What is one choice you have, and one outcome that also depends on others?

entries.quote:
